name: Excalibur Ascendant
description: A legendary knight-dragon fusion forged beyond all known limits. Excalibur Ascendant channels the ancient power of dragonkind through a sacred blade core, its crystalline resonance shattering barriers with every revolution.

special_move.name: Excalibur Triple Strike
special_move.description: The sacred dragon blade ignites as Draciel launches three world-splitting slashes — each infused with pure draconic resonance!
flavour_texts: 🐉 **Strike 2** — Dragon resonance tears the stadium apart!
✨ **Strike 3** — EXCALIBUR TRIPLE STRIKE — SACRED BLADE FINISH!

abilities.name: Dragon Core Resonance
abilities.description: Excalibur Ascendant's dragon core pulses with harmonic energy, granting +20 Attack whenever it wins any phase. Stacks up to 3 times (max +60 Attack). Every 3rd consecutive win the resonance erupts, dealing 25 bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Internal Overdrive
abilities.description: After Excalibur Triple Strike, Excalibur Ascendant enters OVERDRIVE for 4 turns: +30 Attack, enemy Defense ignored entirely, attacks that CANNOT be dodged, guaranteed critical hits, and 20 HP recovered per turn. Nothing interrupts it.

rules._note: '100% crit damage' is read as guaranteed crits at a doubled multiplier: guaranteed_crit makes every hit a crit for the window, crit_damage 2.0 makes each one worth double rather than the usual 1.5x.
